headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY YTD
summary: As of July 2, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 14.81% compared to SPY's 9.43%. This outperformance translates to an average alpha of 5.38%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered a significant return of 43.93%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Google 100', has returned 6.79%, which is still above the benchmark but highlights the variance in performance among the portfolios. This relative strength is particularly noteworthy during periods of market uncertainty, as it signals resilience against broader market trends. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
